description: Ministry of Sports - Order to amend the National Associations of Sports Regulations, No. 01 of 2016 published in the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1990/23 of 27.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973. It amends previous regulations regarding National Associations of Sports, specifying eligibility criteria, committee structures, and operational procedures. The content focuses on legal/regulatory amendments to existing sports legislation, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
